_comment: Editorial fields for firmware-index.json, one entry per release tag. Nothing here is
a hash: sha256, file name and release_tag are filled in by manifests_from_releases.py
from the digest GitHub computes over the stored asset bytes, so a stale hash cannot be
pasted in. That has already gone wrong once here - the SHA256SUMS.txt attached to
v1.1.0-mtb_mpy records the v1.0.0-mtb hash for the mtb-only artifact.
`board`, `sku`, `firmware_uuid` and `firmware_version` are read from the on-device
identity record at 0x60900000 in each published hex, verified 2026-09-02 against the
downloaded release assets. All six report firmware version 1.9.0 - the v1.x.y tags are
SDK-package versions and do not appear in the firmware at all.
`board` is the string the firmware declares about itself, which is the ModusToolbox
TARGET. That is what the consuming contract asks for as of its rev 2: the platform
team confirmed on 2026-09-02 that their earlier `QWA303-B1-1.0` example came from
their own board-package.json and was never measured, and asked for the declared value
unbent. `board` alone cannot separate our AI Kit from our Dev Kit - four projects emit
KIT_PSE84_AI - so `sku` is the per-product key, and it is unique per row.

v1.2.0-mtb_mpy.description: MicroPython on the board — edit and run over the REPL. Sensors, radar, Edge AI, WiFi and HTTPS.

v1.2.0-mtb.description: Plain C across all three cores, with the touch UI. No Python console — the smallest starting point.

v1.1.0-mtb_mpy.reason: Superseded by v1.2.0-mtb_mpy and missing its HTTPS trust-anchor and OPTIGA certificate-pairing fixes. Byte-identical in function to v1.0.0-mtb_mpy: the two differ in exactly 20 bytes, all inside the embedded git-describe string.
v1.1.0-mtb_mpy.description: MicroPython REPL, 44 modules, 64 KB heap. Sensors, radar, Edge AI, WiFi and OPTIGA verified on board.

v1.1.0-mtb.reason: Provenance of the published bytes is unresolved. The release body states the attached file is the one that was flashed and quotes ae6fafa2..., but the stored asset hashes to a1a61934...; ae6fafa2... is the v1.0.0-mtb build. Until it is established which of the two was hardware-tested, this artifact must not be offered to a student.
v1.1.0-mtb.evidence: release body of v1.1.0-mtb; SHA256SUMS.txt attached to v1.1.0-mtb_mpy; GitHub asset digests, all read 2026-09-02
v1.1.0-mtb.description: Plain C across all three cores, with the touch UI. No Python console — the smallest starting point.

v1.0.0-mtb_mpy.reason: The release says so itself: not flashed to a real board. Never offer an untested image from a picker a student trusts.
v1.0.0-mtb_mpy.description: MicroPython REPL plus the full C firmware, 64 KB heap.

v1.0.0-mtb.reason: The release says so itself: not flashed to a real board.
v1.0.0-mtb.description: Plain C across all three cores, with the touch UI. No Python console — the smallest starting point.
